name: TenantImprovementAllowanceTracker
tagline: Every TI allowance, budget line, draw and lien waiver in one Power Apps app.
description: A complete tenant improvement allowance app for landlords and lease administrators: split allowances into budget lines, review and approve draw requests with two-person approval, hold and release retainage, enforce conditional and unconditional lien waivers, and see remaining allowance before it is forfeited.
features: Allowance → budget line → draw ledger with automatic totals
Retainage per allowance, released with the final draw
Two approvers above a configurable limit
Lien waiver sequencing (conditional before payment, unconditional before the next draw)
Line and allowance caps with tolerance
CSV export, undo and dated history
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
